headland.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated 3D environment asset reference for a premium low-poly pirate adventure game. Reference image: use only its tactile weathered Caribbean limestone, restrained lush greenery and handcrafted Pirates of the Caribbean meets the Goonies art direction.
Create ONE magnificent asymmetrical coastal limestone headland rock mass, viewed from a low three-quarter front angle showing its whole volume. Very broad base, approximately twice as wide as tall and deep enough to be a real peninsula. Its silhouette flows from a lower terraced shelf on the left, up to a broken rounded high summit right of centre, then falls in an irregular sloping rocky shoulder to the right. Broad sculpted limestone buttresses, vertical erosion channels, a few deep fissures, flowing horizontal strata, wave-undercut base and scattered low shrubs clinging to ledges. A dark naturally arched smugglers cave entrance low on the left face. The left upper shelf has a generous uneven bare stone area where a separate fort could stand. Pale warm grey limestone with cool desaturated turquoise crevices, sparse rich olive greenery, dark wet lower rocks. Important: bold large sculptural forms, elegant flowing contours, interesting negative spaces, beautifully authored hand-painted PBR textures, slight stylization, high quality game asset. Tiny cracks subordinate to the big forms.
Isolate the entire single rock formation against transparent background, complete silhouette visible with margin. Neutral soft asset lighting, no directional sunset or cast ground shadow. No fort, buildings, ocean, sky, flat ground platform, plinth, rectangular cut ends, square footprint, stacked cube rocks, repeated stone columns, regular grid, text or people. Do not copy the pier, boats, buildings or character from the reference. This is a solid naturally shaped headland, not a framed landscape or flat wall panel.
